data.name: Dark Dice: Cthulhu Investigation Log
data.detailed_description:
Some doors, once opened, do not close.

DarkDice is a dice-driven investigation log set across Lovecraft's Mythos, built for investigators who want real stakes behind every choice.

Recruit and manage an Investigation Team at your Society's HQ, then send an investigator into one of seventeen standalone cases set across the Cthulhu Mythos: The Mountains of Madness, The Colour Out of Space, The Dunwich Horror, Innsmouth, and more. Read the file, weigh the risk, and step through the door — because once you cross that threshold, there's no turning back until you've escaped or fallen.

Features

  • Dice-and-skill investigation — every check draws on real Cthulhu-style TRPG stats, not scripted outcomes for a single path or ending.

  • Eight investigator professions — Professor, Antiquarian, Patrolman, Athlete, Actor, Politician, Private Investigator, Doctor. A short in-fiction psychology quiz reads your answers and matches you to the archetype your choices actually point to, each with its own skill spread, Credit Rating, and personal hook into the case.

  • Sanity has a cost — your mind erodes with your choices, and a broken investigator plays differently than a sharp one.

  • Permadeath, permanent consequences — no reloading past a bad roll. If your investigator falls, that story ends.

  • Seventeen Mythos cases — set in the world of Lovecraft's Mythos and Chambers' King in Yellow, each a self-contained investigation.

  • Investigation Team HQ — build a roster between cases, gather Ancient Knowledge and Merit, equip your team from a growing item pool.

  • Fully bilingual — English and Chinese (Traditional & Simplified) both fully supported.

  • No internet required — entirely offline single-player; Steam Achievements and Cloud saves are optional extras that never gate play.

Whether you're a veteran of Cthulhu or new to the Mythos, DarkDice asks the same question every case: how much of yourself are you willing to lose to know the truth?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card (e.g. Intel HD Graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard sound card
